title: Remaining tenant runtime migration governed readiness

phases.objective: Provide one exact-token, Production-bound and checksum-bound readiness vehicle for the remaining tenant runtime lifecycle migration. The vehicle may establish governed migration executor readiness metadata, record/read back checksum-bound authorization, and execute dry-run only while keeping Migration Apply, CMS reconciliation apply, Support Ticket reconciliation apply, live tenant repair, provider calls, credential payload access, external writes, deployment and protected-ref mutation outside this authority domain.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Issue 6871 exact authorization comment on the trusted default-branch workflow
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The trusted workflow proves exact PR #6851 migration identity and Production/runtime parity at the pinned SHA, creates or approves a short-lived authorization-bootstrap capability envelope, records and durably reads back checksum-bound migration authorization, completes governed_migration_execute in dry_run mode with applies_sql=false and zero preflight risks, and re-pins Production without executing migration SQL or any tenant/provider mutation.
steps: Require issue 6871, the exact canonical migration authorization token, and OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR association before the readiness job can start.
Require source PR 6851 merge identity, exact migration Git blob SHA, SHA-256 checksum, and executable statement count to remain pinned.
Require protected Production plus public /health, /version, /deployment-info and /connector-agent/version readbacks to equal 9ed415e324d8d5187b2c29bdf16aaf77187f0333.
Re-read protected Production immediately before authorization mutation and fail closed on drift.
Create or approve a short-lived capability resolution envelope scoped to governed_migration_authorization_bootstrap and the exact migration resource binding.
Use the canonical governed migration authorization bootstrap with executor readiness mode ensure, then durably verify exactly one checksum/source-bound authorization row.
Invoke governed_migration_execute only with mode dry_run and require applies_sql=false, exact checksum, exact statement count and zero preflight risks.
Re-read protected Production again after dry-run and upload sanitized evidence with all prohibited mutation flags false.
assertions: Production ref drift, runtime drift, source PR drift, migration blob drift, SHA-256 drift, statement-count drift, authorization mismatch, or dry-run preflight risk fails closed.
The workflow exposes no Migration Apply phase or token.
The executor never invokes governed_migration_execute with mode apply and never requests capability_resolution_envelope_apply_authorize.
The executor does not invoke CMS authority reconciliation apply or Support Ticket resolution reconciliation apply.
No provider call, credential payload read, external send/write, live tenant repair, protected-ref mutation, force push or deployment occurs.

The only intended state mutations in this readiness authority domain are short-lived capability-envelope lifecycle records, migration executor readiness metadata bootstrap/ensure, and the checksum-bound governed migration authorization record.
